table.name: concert
table.purpose: One row per concert (episode of a singing-competition show) held at a stadium, with its theme and year. Concert names like 'Auditions', 'Super bootcamp', 'Week 1' suggest TV-show episodes rather than generic concerts (tentative).

Stadium_ID.name: Stadium ID
Stadium_ID.description: Foreign key to stadium.Stadium_ID, the venue where the concert took place.

Theme.name: Theme
Theme.description: Theme of the concert episode (e.g. 'Free choice', 'Bleeding Love', 'Party All Night').

Year.name: Year
Year.description: Year the concert took place (2014 or 2015).

concert_ID.name: Concert ID
concert_ID.description: Primary key identifying the concert; referenced by singer_in_concert.

concert_Name.name: Concert name
concert_Name.description: Name of the concert/episode, e.g. 'Auditions', 'Super bootcamp', 'Week 1'.

table.name: singer
table.purpose: One row per singer, with demographics and the song they performed.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Age of the singer in years (25-52).

Country.name: Country
Country.description: Country of origin of the singer (France, Netherlands, United States).

Is_male.name: Is male
Is_male.description: Boolean flag stored as 'T'/'F' indicating whether the singer is male.

Singer_ID.name: Singer ID
Singer_ID.description: Primary key identifying the singer; referenced by singer_in_concert.

Song_Name.name: Song name
Song_Name.description: Name of the song the singer performed (e.g. 'Hey Oh', 'Gentleman').

Song_release_year.name: Song release year
Song_release_year.description: Year the performed song was released (1992-2016).

table.name: singer_in_concert
table.purpose: Junction table linking singers to the concerts they performed in (many-to-many).

Singer_ID.name: Singer ID
Singer_ID.description: Foreign key to singer.Singer_ID, the singer performing in the concert.

concert_ID.name: Concert ID
concert_ID.description: Foreign key to concert.concert_ID, the concert the singer performed in.

table.name: stadium
table.purpose: One row per stadium (Scottish football grounds), with capacity and attendance statistics. The 'Location' column actually holds the resident club name (e.g. 'Ayr United', 'Queen's Park'), and Highest/Lowest/Average appear to be attendance figures.

Average.name: Average attendance
Average.description: Average attendance at the stadium (552-2106); the value consistently lies between the Lowest and Highest attendance figures, supporting the average-attendance reading.

Highest.name: Highest attendance
Highest.description: Highest recorded attendance at the stadium (780-4812); consistently the largest of the three attendance figures, supporting the highest-attendance reading.

Location.name: Location / resident club
Location.description: Despite the name, values are football club names (e.g. 'Ayr United', 'East Fife'), i.e. the club based at the stadium rather than a city.

Lowest.name: Lowest attendance
Lowest.description: Lowest recorded attendance at the stadium (315-1294); consistently the smallest of the three attendance figures, supporting the lowest-attendance reading.

Name.name: Stadium name
Name.description: Name of the stadium (e.g. 'Hampden Park', 'Somerset Park').

Stadium_ID.name: Stadium ID
Stadium_ID.description: Primary key identifying the stadium; referenced by concert.Stadium_ID.
